title: Unified 5D Topology Component
description: Single neutral TopologyV1 model, shared TopologyStore, FiveD flat|spatial, paired connect/LOD semantics across @puzzle/2d and @puzzle/3d.
summary: TopologyPairedPolicy documents LOD (6 flat tiers vs spatial continuous) and connect gestures (indirect cross-surface via TopologyConnectSession; proximity local to flat drag / spatial relocate). Fixed BoardCanvas onConnect to edgeCreate only. FiveD flat/spatial LOD defaults split; spatial proximityRelocateEnabled explicit. data-five-d-indirect-active for e2e.
